I'm a quantum computing researcher and engineer based in Poland. My background spans mathematics, theoretical physics, and computer science — three Bachelor's, two Master's, and a recently completed PhD on *spectral gaps, t-designs and ε-nets in quantum computing* under [Prof. Adam Sawicki](https://quantmath.pl/team/adam-sawicki/) at the Center for Theoretical Physics, Polish Academy of Sciences.

I currently work as a Senior Quantum Engineer at PwC's innovation hub. Past stops include [Phasecraft](https://phasecraft.io/) (quantum software consulting in London) and the [IDUB ion-trap project](https://www.it.pw.edu.pl/) at Warsaw University of Technology. I'm a [Qiskit Advocate](https://qiskit.org/advocates/) and have worked with the IBM Quantum stack since 2020.

## What I work on

- **Efficiency of quantum gates and compilers** — how to approximate arbitrary unitaries with the smallest possible circuits.
- **t-designs and ε-nets** — the mathematical structures that govern how well a finite set of gates covers the unitary group.
- **Reliability of quantum hardware** — characterising and mitigating noise on real devices, especially crosstalk in readout.
- **Ion-trap quantum computing** — the full stack, from algorithms down to control electronics.
- **Quantum error correction** — LDPC codes and their practical implementation.

## Elsewhere

Outside research I build things — most recently exploring tooling for procedural 3D character generation and formal legal reasoning systems. I write about both on the [blog](posts/index.qmd).
